description: Rep. Thomas Oppel (D-Canaan) planned to bring an amendment to the House floor allowing the legislature to impose progressive income taxes to fund public schools and offset local property taxes. As reported by NH Journal, Oppel was tied to former Executive Councilor Andru Volinsky’s property tax group, and Republicans signaled they welcomed a recorded vote ... Read more
